title: Budget of a hypothetical government
body: The following data (in Rs crore) relate to the budget of a hypothetical central government for one financial year. Revenue receipts: 900 (tax revenue 750 and non-tax revenue 150). Revenue expenditure: 1,200, of which interest payments are 350. Capital expenditure: 400. Capital receipts: recovery of loans 20, proceeds from disinvestment of PSU shares 30, and borrowings and other liabilities 650. Assume that interest receipts of the government are negligible, so net interest liabilities equal interest payments.
